Elena (Partnerships): Heads-up — we need partner coordination for a planned change to the runtime adapter handshake that will affect partner SDKs and marketplace images. Proposal: bump runtime contract to v3, remove legacy sig header, and require a small metadata blob in /handshake. Need partner comms + runbook + canary plan. ETA: 2 weeks.
Sam (Platform): Can you paste the exact fields that are changing? we'll check marketplace image versions.
Elena (Partnerships): Main diffs: header `X-Runtime-Sig` -> `X-Runtime-Auth`, new `runtime-capabilities` JSON blob in body. SDKs should send `capabilities: ["kv-cache","streaming"]` when advertising features. Backcompat window: 30 days with a shim available.
Maya (Solutions): Recommend we offer a compatibility shim (tiny proxy) partners can drop-in if they can't update immediately. @Ryan do we have CI to build shim images for partner HW?
Ryan (DevEx): We can build a shim container. Suggest canary set: 5 partners (mix of HW OEMs + marketplace vendors) + marketplace small subset, route 5% traffic. Also add a feature-flag server-side to accept the old header for the initial canary. Need telemetry: handshake success, header-mismatch, fallback-kernel-count, latency-p90.
Jin (Eng Runtime): On runtime: kernel selection will use `capabilities` to pick quantized kernels. If missing, we fallback to conservative kernel (adds ~30ms). Canary must measure fallback rate and any timeouts. Also watch for signature validation errors once we enforce `X-Runtime-Auth`.
Maya (Solutions): Docs & samples: Node + Go snippets, upgrade checklist, and rollback steps. I'll draft partner-facing checklist and sample code and send to partners by EOD tomorrow.
Elena (Partnerships): Owners: docs=Maya, shim=Ryan, runtime=Jin, comms=Elena. Action items: create partner-facing preflight checklist, signed acceptance form, and schedule a tabletop (Wed 10am PT). @all please ack.
Sam (Platform): ack
Ryan (DevEx): ack — I'll open a PR in `partner-shim` to add `X-Runtime-Auth` support and a CI matrix for HW images.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary window Wed 10:00-12:00 PT; canary pipeline will create dedicated canary stacks for the 5 partners and route 5% traffic.
Elena (Partnerships): Also: add telemetry tag `partner_compat:v3` to traces and logs for easy querying.
Maya (Solutions): Drafting partner email now. Sample curl to include in docs: 
```
curl -X POST https://runtime.redwood.ai/handshake \ 
  -H 'X-Runtime-Auth: <token>' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"capabilities":["kv-cache","streaming"]}'
```
Jin (Eng Runtime): One more migration note: partners using cached KV will need to rotate cache keys when we change the handshake; include cache-rotation as a step in the checklist.
Sam (Platform): Noted — I'll flag marketplace images that need an update and prepare a list to notify vendors.
Ryan (DevEx): Proposed timeline: PRs by EOD Fri, internal canary Mon, partner canary Wed, full roll Fri (week after).
Elena (Partnerships): Perfect, thanks everyone :pray: We'll sync Wed tabletop.
